en.headline: Customs drug seizures rise nearly 50 per cent in first half of 2026
en.dek: Officers confiscated 5,704 kg of narcotics, with cannabis and ketamine making up about 60 per cent, and notable increases recorded on air and sea routes.
body: Hong Kong Customs recorded a nearly 50 per cent year-on-year rise in drug seizures in the first half of 2026, confiscating 5,704 kilograms of illegal narcotics, according to figures reported on Monday.

Nearly two-thirds of the total, or 3,408 kg, was found at the airport, up 46.6 per cent. Sea routes accounted for 1,954 kg, a 55.6 per cent increase, while the remaining 342 kg was seized at land checkpoints and elsewhere.
Cannabis and ketamine together made up about 60 per cent of the seizures, rising 40 per cent and 78.8 per cent respectively. The number of drug cases and arrests also edged higher.

The figures come amid several large recent busts, including a record 535 kg of cannabis buds hidden in insulated boxes from Thailand and a 13 kg ketamine seizure at the airport involving a Japanese passenger.

zh.headline: 海關上半年檢獲毒品量升近五成 大麻氯胺酮佔六成
zh.dek: 海關今年上半年檢獲5,704公斤毒品，較去年同期升近五成，當中大麻及氯胺酮約佔六成，空運及海運路線檢獲量均明顯上升。
body: 香港海關周一公布，2026年上半年檢獲非法毒品合共5,704公斤，按年上升近五成。
其中約三分二、即3,408公斤在機場檢獲，升46.6%；海運路線佔1,954公斤，升55.6%；其餘342公斤則在陸路口岸及其他地方檢獲。
大麻及氯胺酮合共約佔六成檢獲量，分別上升40%及78.8%。毒品案件宗數及被捕人數亦輕微上升。
數字公布之際，海關近期亦有多宗大型行動，包括從泰國抵港貨櫃檢獲創紀錄535公斤大麻花蕾，以及機場檢獲13公斤疑似氯胺酮並拘捕一名日本籍乘客。
